limitations: Fresh browser per trial; operating-system disk/code caches are not cleared
Route interception measures served response-body bytes, not real network/TLS/compressed traffic
Sampled browser-tree RSS sums shared pages and includes browser/runtime overhead; it is not unique physical or decoder-retained memory
CDP renderer JS heap after forced GC excludes dedicated worker heaps, media decoders and native allocations
Observed CPU maxima miss work of processes born and exited between samples
No whole-process peak-retained-memory qualification, independent FFmpeg performance comparator, large-file throughput or release approval
